found_in_G0 (supervisor reproduced 2026-10-20: FOO/TMPDIR/LANG unset in 5.3 when set by the 5.2 caller): tools/timing_check.sh --bash OTHER-RUNTIME loses TC_REEXEC and the caller env (KT_STORM_*, TMPDIR) across the switch — re-execs twice (harmless) and runs without the caller env; fix with the gate spec-file approach (G4 or a separate item)

found_in_G1 (5.3, full sweep load, 2026-10-20, first time seen in any sweep log): 045 "unfiltered: a tree rooted at timeout 8 ..." — kt_strays_stop sent TERM (grace 3 s used) then KILL by pid 20x over 2 s, the timeout root + its TERM-ignoring child were still alive -> "2 process(es) LEFT", rc 1. Identity check passed (signals were sent), so SIGKILL delivery itself lagged > 2 s under load. Matters for gate: a false "could NOT be stopped" makes a cell STRAY. Proposal: kt_strays_stop KILL phase polls until gone up to ~10 s (fork-free), and reports LEFT only after that; G2 worker to take it as a ktests fix with a test, or a separate item
